v6.25.4.edition: URGENT M10 freshness fix -- continuationEntryPaused decoupled from data staleness
v6.25.4.compiler_result: 0 errors, 0 warnings (MetaEditor64.exe, isolated sandbox + owner's Mac live MT5 install, hash-identical: b13892889d51640ba2c693e32d5dcb2dc356dc6fdcb95ed939da49fc97817d40 -- VPS NOT verified, this session has no remote access to it; the EA is copied into the Mac's live Experts folder but MT5 does not hot-reload an already-attached expert, so the owner must detach/reattach the EA (or restart the terminal) for this build to actually take effect there)
v6.25.4.release_notes: URGENT root-cause fix for a live incident (16:50:30, a genuinely fresh M10 bar at closeAgeSeconds=30 was reported freshnessState=STALE, rejecting a valid BUY/TREND_PULLBACK candidate). Root cause: XAU_BuildM10EvidenceSnapshot() used td.continuationEntryPaused as a proxy for 'this bar's data is incomplete', but that field is actually !continuationEntryAllowed -- a real market-condition signal (true whenever exhaustion/transition readings currently disfavor a continuation-direction entry), completely unrelated to data availability. Any ordinary exhaustion/transition reading was forcing the entire M10 evidence snapshot to STALE regardless of how fresh the bar actually was. Fixed by separating freshness (bar identity only: evaluatedShift) from a new dataState axis (driven by a new evidenceDataUnavailable field, set true only in the two genuine fail-closed branches of XAU_AdaptiveMarketTransitionEngine() -- missing closed-bar/ATR/close price, or the bar being more than 2x the primary period old). STALE now always carries an explicit staleCause (NO_EVALUATED_BAR / BAR_MORE_THAN_ONE_CLOSED_M10_BEHIND / BAR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH). No approved trading behavior (risk, SL widening, timing, direction exclusivity, R-Exit, basket protection, exhaustion evidence-only, M10 primary authority) was altered -- this only fixes which readings are allowed to reach the unchanged decision logic. Also fixes a Phase 17 release-identity mismatch found during the same audit: #property version was still "6.259" (matching no real release) and #property description still said "v6.25.1" -- both now correctly read 6.254/v6.25.4, matching XAUAI_EA_VERSION and this manifest.

v6.25.5.compiler_result: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 66608 ms elapsed (MetaEditor64.exe, isolated wine sandbox only -- NOT YET verified on the owner's Mac live install or VPS; do not treat as hash-confirmed across all three until that verification happens, and this build has NOT been deployed to either live terminal by this session)
v6.25.5.release_notes: Adds a new optional, selectable InpDecisionMode setting (default XAU_DECISION_M10_LEGACY = 0, unchanged current behavior). The second mode, XAU_DECISION_M30_THREE_M10_CONSENSUS, requires three consecutive completed M10 evidence snapshots (recorded into a new immutable per-bar history buffer every 10 minutes in BOTH modes) to combine into one recency-weighted (20%/30%/50%, reusing M10's own existing 55.0 qualification score and 10.0 directional-gap constants -- no new scoring thresholds invented) consensus decision, resolved only once per 30-minute wall-clock slot (pure broker-server epoch arithmetic, not chart timeframe or MqlDateTime field mutation). In M30 mode, individual M10 scans can no longer independently originate or veto a normal trade candidate -- audited every call site reaching OpenTrade() (PRIMARY scan, RE_ENTRY, and the two human-triggered Command Center overrides FORCE_OPEN_TRADE/MANUAL_OPEN_NOW, the latter two deliberately left ungated since they are explicit human actions, not autonomous origination) to confirm this. Pyramid adds and Counter-Excursion are unaffected (both already bypass OpenTrade() via their own isolated execution paths, per existing architecture, and are explicitly out of scope per the owner spec). Restart-safety persists a single scalar (last processed 30-minute slot) via the existing terminal-scoped GlobalVariable mechanism, scoped by account+broker+symbol+magic+EA version, so a restart can never re-derive/re-execute an already-resolved slot; the evidence history buffer is deliberately NOT persisted across restarts (rebuilds from live data within at most 30 minutes) -- a disclosed trade-off, not a silent gap. No risk, SL, exit, timing, or entry-execution logic was touched -- the M30 gate produces the same signal/setupName/setupScore shape M10-legacy already produces and falls through into the exact same unchanged downstream pipeline (SMC/personality/regime scoring, FinalEntryArbiter, entry timer, risk sizing, OpenTrade). Command Center now displays the three most recent M10 evidence records and the current M30 consensus object when the mode is active (backend BotActivityReq.m30_consensus field, frontend M30ConsensusCard) -- entirely dormant/empty when running in legacy mode. NOT achievable from this development environment and therefore explicitly unproven: a live-tick replay comparison against historical M10 evidence, and demo/live MT5 journal proof of the M30 mode actually executing a trade. Per owner directive, this build has not been made live/default and has not been deployed to the Mac or VPS live terminals -- InpDecisionMode remains legacy for every currently-running instance regardless of this release existing.
